articles.title: Warren: What is White House doing to prevent a repeat of teleprompter's Trump bets?
articles.snippet: U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren argued the administration is not doing enough about staff insider trading, questioning whether CFTC enforcement action was sufficient.

articles.title: Trump Media Posts $410 Million Profit. Bitcoin Gains Did the Heavy Lifting
articles.snippet: Truth Social’s parent booked $409.7 million in quarterly income largely from crypto investments, even as its stock remained more than 94% below its March 2024 peak.

articles.title: 'Tough Questions' Ahead: Warren Targets Prediction Markets, Trump Crypto as Banking Chair
articles.snippet: An aide said Trump family crypto businesses should "preserve their documents" as Warren prepares to take over the Senate Banking Committee.
